newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices gain on increased buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices gain on increased buying.

text.p: Indian sugar prices gained on Tuesday on increased physical buying for new festivals coupled with limited supplies, dealers said.
They said there was higher outstation demand particularly from northern and central India which in turn curtailed arrivals from mills.

Among ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 7/10 rupees to 1,270/1,290 rupees while M-30 gained by 5/10 rupees to 1,300/1,350 rupees. Sugar mill delivery moved up from 1,195/1,210 rupees to 1,215/1,235 rupees.
